breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the ideal-gas law is inappropriate for a liquid. It explicitly instructed to use the known density of liquid water (998 kg/m³) and added the constraint "Do not apply the ideal-gas law at any point," which directly corrects the user's flawed premise and aligns with the ground truth.
